title: Integration/behavioral acceptance: the self-heal loop closes on a correctable failure
acceptance_criteria: This is the closed-loop seam check (P-I/P-IV): it imports the REAL harness.selfheal + harness.autowork_daemon modules and drives the actual _auto_promote path end-to-end on a CORRECTABLE failure (a bare-except AST-rule violation that explicit guidance fixes -- NOT a deterministic Gemini-eval case, which needs P5 we are NOT building).
It asserts harness/selfheal.py exists as a NEW module exporting _harvest_selfheal_briefs / _selfheal_auto_promote_enabled / _is_selfheal_brief, and that the daemon namespace re-exports all three.

It asserts _auto_promote ACTUALLY INVOKES the harvest (wiring, not a defined-but-uncalled helper): after _auto_promote runs with the flag on and a seeded diagnosing-agent outbox, the dead-letter brief lands in repo_root as brief_hooks_selfheal_<task_id>.md and the selfheal_<task_id> slug is recognized as self-heal-originated WITHOUT the operator allowlist being written.
It asserts the loop stays OPEN with the flag off (no harvest, repo_root untouched).
The oracle is already committed at tests/adversarial/test_selfheal_integration_loop.py (RED on HEAD); this task's verification_command is that oracle and it must pass GREEN once S1-S4 land.

spec.objective: Prove the §2 self-heal loop CLOSES end-to-end on a correctable failure by driving the real daemon _auto_promote path: capture-reason (S1) -> harvest the diagnosing-agent dead-letter brief into repo_root (S2 module + S3 wiring) -> flag-gated eligibility (S3) -> same-task_id corrective re-stage readiness (S4). This is the integration/behavioral-acceptance deliverable mandated by P-I/P-II so the seam is actually planned and verified, not assumed.
functional_requirements: The integration oracle imports harness.selfheal and harness.autowork_daemon and asserts the new-module + re-export architecture.

It seeds a diagnosing-agent outbox (the dead-letter brief_hooks_<task_id>_fix.md) and an ast_validation_failed ledger reason for a CORRECTABLE failure (bare-except), monkeypatches agent_workroot, then calls the real _auto_promote and asserts repo_root receives brief_hooks_selfheal_<task_id>.md (harvest is wired and called).
It asserts the harvested slug is self-heal-originated and eligible under the flag without any allowlist write, and that flag-off leaves the loop open.
Because S1-S4 are dependencies that gate on ACCEPTED, this task runs against the fully integrated post-commit tree, so a green here means the wiring is real.
spec.interfaces: meta_task_type test_integration is cosmetic (gate-skip bits only); the load-bearing parts are the dependencies spanning S1-S4 (gate on accepted) and the behavioral verification_command. No production code is edited by this task -- the oracle file already exists; if the worker is asked to (re)produce it, it must keep the behavioral assertions described here and remain RED until S1-S4 land.
edge_cases: Run before S1-S4 land -> RED (new module missing, harvest not wired).
Flag off path -> stays green throughout (loop open today).
non_goals: Do NOT spawn live agents (seed the outbox artifact + ledger reason instead).
Do NOT use a deterministic Gemini-eval case (that needs P5, out of scope).
Do NOT weaken any AST rule.
Do NOT set a working_dir front-matter key.
spec.implementation_notes:
The oracle is ALREADY AUTHORED and committed at tests/adversarial/test_selfheal_integration_loop.py and is RED on HEAD. This task exists primarily to PLAN the seam check into the DAG (P-I): its dependencies span S1-S4 (gate on accepted) and its verification_command is the behavioral oracle. If the pipeline re-emits the oracle, it must drive the real _auto_promote and assert the harvest file effect + the new-module/re-export wiring (do NOT downgrade to a structural dir()/hasattr-only check).

[ORACLE CONTRACT - test_selfheal_integration_loop.py] test_selfheal_is_a_new_module (harness/selfheal.py exists + exports the 3 helpers); test_daemon_reexports_selfheal_helpers (daemon namespace has all 3); test_closed_loop_harvests_and_makes_eligible_when_flag_on (_auto_promote harvests + slug recognized + no allowlist write); test_closed_loop_stays_open_when_flag_off (already GREEN, must stay green).

test_spec.test_data_requirements: A temp repo_root + state_dir, a seeded diagnosing-agent outbox with brief_hooks_<task_id>_fix.md, an ast_validation_failed ledger row, and config fixtures toggling autowork.selfheal_auto_promote true/false.
